name: ragged-pld-identity-guards
status: implemented (diagnostic driver repair); CPU-tested through host seams and synthetic metadata/stat fixtures only; never run natively, never run on a model or real artifact; nothing is qualified, selected or observed-used
license: Apache-2.0 (mlx2 LICENSE); original local diagnostic repair, no third-party code or text copied; no Apple copyright header
origin: original mlx2 repair of the existing ragged PLD qualification driver; not mined from mlx-lm-unified or any other repository. Gate ordering informed by the local scripts/probe_native_mtp_head_d1.py (source/build/module refusal order) and scripts/paired_direct_ab.py (mlx_identity fields), both read only and unchanged; the native-MTP head requirement of D1 is deliberately not copied

baseline.defect: root source audit (stage 36): run_all constructed Driver before any source identity; Driver resolved and constructed the adapter (loading the model) before collecting module paths or the MLX build identity; the receipt took source/build identity only after every arm, through paired_direct_ab.source_identity, which records a failed git status as dirty=False. Nothing bound the run to the source, build, artifact or prompt file it started with

modifications: preflight (standard library, before any native import): strict source identity of the required files with git failures recorded as None and refused (never clean): 40-hex HEAD from rev-parse --verify, git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all known and empty, git ls-files --error-unmatch succeeding, a lowercase sha256 for every required file and exactly the required file set. Required files = IDENTITY_FILES (the previous six plus prompt_lookup, sample_utils, adapters/registry, contracts, serving) + the selected family's adapter, config and model files

metadata/stat artifact manifest in the selected adapter's own fingerprint recipe: Muse (muse_glimmer.inspect_artifact) hashes five metadata files (config.json, model.safetensors.index.json, tokenizer.json, tokenizer_config.json, chat_template.jinja) and allows the single-shard model.safetensors convention without an index; Qwen3.8 27B and Qwen3.6 35B-A3B inspectors hash six (adding generation_config.json) and require the index. Each present file contributes name + bytes, then json.dumps((name, size, mtime_ns)) per sorted shard. Shards must be non-empty relative names without '..', resolve inside the artifact, end in .safetensors and exist; the weight map must be a nonempty object of string shard names; a metadata name that exists but is not a regular file refuses. Shards are stat'ed only, never opened

dispatch mirrored from registry._RESOLVERS for the supported families only (muse_glimmer/muse_glimmer_text; qwen3_5 at topology (64, 5120) without experts; qwen3_5_moe except (48, 3072)); drafters, other topologies and other model types refuse. North (cohere2_moe) refuses explicitly: its inspector folds safetensors header digests into the fingerprint, which a metadata/stat-only preflight cannot reproduce. No identity is invented for unsupported families

--prompt-ids is read once in the preflight (bounded to 64 MiB) and hashed; Driver parses those same bytes (load_workload(path, raw=...)), and the file is re-hashed after the arms. pld_policy, lane_policies, lanes and ignore_eos join the protocol section

Driver.__init__ gate order (native imports only through the module seam _import): no clean preflight -> refuse before importing MLX; import mlx.core; build identity (paired_direct_ab.mlx_identity: version, package, absolute existing core path, lowercase metallib sha256, GPU device; a collector exception such as a missing __version__/default_device or an unreadable metallib is itself a refusal via collect_build_identity) -> refuse before any mlx2 import; resolve_adapter; dispatched class must equal the family adapter, its module file must be this worktree's adapter file at the preflight sha256, every loaded mlx2 module (and scripts.paired_direct_ab) must be a .py file under this worktree, clean and tracked, and loaded files the preflight hashed must still carry that hash -> refuse before cls(model); cls(model); adapter identity path, fingerprint and shard records (Muse top-level, Qwen nested artifact['identity']) must equal the manifest and no drafter may be bound -> refuse before any arm; import serving and the route modules, then the full loaded-module closure check -> refuse before any arm

run_all: preflight refusal or IdentityRefusal returns an explicit unexecuted receipt (executed false, arms_executed [], refused_at stage, verdict refused, refusals, results {}, comparisons [], coverage null, ordinary_geometry not_run, stop_tokens 'not resolved') instead of a crash or a missing identity

post_run_identity after the arms: source identity re-taken and compared (commit, status, tracked, every file hash), prompt file re-hashed, artifact manifest re-taken (path, family, fingerprint, metadata hashes, shard records), MLX build identity re-taken through collect_build_identity and compared, loaded-module closure re-checked with every pre-arm module file unchanged and still loaded, adapter identity snapshot unchanged. Any drift sets verdict refused with refused_at post-run while keeping the real results, comparisons and coverage; identity refusals are listed in identity_refusals and prefixed into refusals

identity-collection failures (COLLECTION_ERRORS: AttributeError, ImportError, KeyError, OSError, RuntimeError, TypeError, ValueError) are refusals, not crashes: at the build gate before any mlx2 import, and after the arms through checked_post_run_identity, which keeps executed true, arms_executed and the real results. Only identity collection is guarded: run_all's one try wraps Driver construction and catches IdentityRefusal alone; nothing wraps the arms, so decode failures still raise

main prints verdict, executed, refused_at, ordinary_geometry, coverage and refusals with .get and iterates comparisons only when present, so a refused receipt prints safely; exit stays 0 only for pass

--i-own-the-gpu is kept as the caller's assertion; receipts state gpu_ownership 'asserted by the caller ... not acquired or verified here (the external admission wrapper remains mandatory)'. This change adds no ownership enforcement

--tiny records the same source (and prompt) identity without enforcing it: identity_gate 'recorded only', identity_advisory lists what would have refused; tiny behaviour and scope are otherwise unchanged

unchanged: v2 row/state/continuation evidence helpers, compare, coverage, verdict ordering, the ordinary_b1 primary reference, state_digest, snapshot_refusal, scripts/paired_direct_ab.py, all production/math/defaults and adapter-owned code

The file now collects 91 nodes (44 test functions); the 62 nodes untouched by either revision ran once in the full-file run

EXECUTED collector failures: build collector raising AttributeError, OSError or RuntimeError refuses at the build stage with events [import mlx.core, build] and identity {mlx: None}; the real paired_direct_ab.mlx_identity over host objects lacking __file__ or default_device is a refusal; a post-run build-collector OSError and a post-run module-listing RuntimeError each give verdict refused, refused_at post-run, executed true and results, comparisons and coverage identical to the clean run

EXECUTED over synthetic metadata/stat fixtures (shards created with permissions removed so any read fails; their stat only): each family's fingerprint equals an independent recompute; generation_config.json binds Qwen but not Muse; absent optional metadata skipped; shard mtime and size drift change the fingerprint; Muse single-shard convention and the Qwen index requirement; traversal, absolute, escaping symlink, wrong suffix, missing shard; empty/non-object/absent weight_map and non-string shard; unreadable index/config, metadata directory, missing artifact; drafter, North, Qwen3.5 4B/9B topology, Qwen dense with experts, 122B and unknown model types

EXECUTED source identity: git OSError, timeout and nonzero exit give commit None, status unknown (dirty None, never False), untracked, and refuse; dirty and untracked refuse; missing file has no hash; ten malformed identity shapes; identity_changes names moved commit and file hashes

EXECUTED build/module/adapter guards: eight missing or invalid build identities (metallib, package, version, device, CPU device, relative and nonexistent path); foreign, None, relative, .pyc, outside-package and misplaced-oracle module files; closure dirty and preflight-hash drift; adapter class, file and hash mismatch; adapter identity in Muse top-level and Qwen nested shapes, with fingerprint, path, shard-record and drafter mismatches

EXECUTED gate ORDER through host seams (Q._import, Q.build_identity, Q.loaded_module_files return host stand-ins; no MLX import, no adapter, model or array): preflight imports nothing native; success order import mlx.core < build < import registry < resolve < construct < import serving; invalid build stops after [import mlx.core, build]; foreign module, wrong dispatch, dispatch error and a commit between preflight and import refuse before construct; adapter identity mismatch refuses before serving is imported; missing preflight refuses with no import

EXECUTED run_all/main with host arms (Driver.run and Driver.continuation substituted; the rest of run_all is real): a clean run is executed with identity_refusals [] and its own verdict (coverage_refused, never pass); eight mid-arm drifts (shard mtime, HEAD, dirty status, prompt file, metallib, foreign module, unloaded module, adapter fingerprint) each give verdict refused, refused_at post-run, executed true and results/comparisons identical to the clean run; preflight refusals (git, North, missing shard, missing prompt file, untracked) write an unexecuted receipt with no native import and no Driver; an adapter identity refusal writes an unexecuted receipt with no arm; main prints refused receipts safely and returns 1

SOURCE ORDER (AST), not executed: Driver.__init__ contains no import statement (only the seam) and calls _import('mlx.core'), collect_build_identity, _import('mlx2.adapters.registry'), resolve_adapter, module_closure_refusals(before_adapter), cls(args.model), adapter_identity_refusals, _import('mlx2.serving'), module_closure_refusals(before_arms) in that line order; run_all calls preflight < refused_receipt < Driver < driver.run < checked_post_run_identity; run_all has exactly one try (Driver construction, IdentityRefusal handler) and checked_post_run_identity guards only its post_run_identity call with COLLECTION_ERRORS. Recipe tuples, the shard record expression, the Muse single-shard default, the Muse/Qwen identity assignments, North's header-digest use and registry._RESOLVERS/topology guards are read by AST from the real sources
ruff: scripts/qualify_ragged_pld.py reports exactly its baseline findings (EXE001, I001, F841); the new test file is clean; git diff --check clean; this file parses with json.tool

not run (by instruction): tests/test_qualify_ragged_pld.py, tests/test_ragged_pld_evidence_cpu.py (the independently verified 99 checks and 9 mutation controls), --tiny, any model, D1, paired, Metal or completed probe
limitations: the gate order is proven with host stand-ins for MLX, the registry, the adapter and sys.modules; no real MLX build, mlx2 import, adapter construction or model has passed or failed these gates
the artifact fingerprint binds metadata bytes and shard name/size/mtime_ns only: it is not tensor-byte verification, and a same-size shard rewritten with a restored mtime is not detected

only Muse, Qwen3.8 27B and Qwen3.6 35B-A3B are bindable; North and every other family refuse. A North ragged gate needs a recipe that also reproduces its safetensors header digests (bounded header reads), which is a root decision
the loaded-module closure binds mlx2 modules and the digest oracle; third-party packages other than MLX (numpy, transformers, tokenizers) are not hashed
required files must be committed and clean: the native run must start from a commit that contains this change
GPU ownership is not enforced here; --i-own-the-gpu remains an assertion and the external admission wrapper is mandatory
old receipts are not re-validated; no qualification, production selection or performance claim follows from this change
